items.name: Teak sideboard, tapered legs
items.reason: Mid-century teak case pieces resell quickly; this one looks intact with original hardware.

items.name: Framed oil landscape
items.reason: Original oil in a period frame; worth a dealer's look before it goes in a box.

items.name: Wool area rug, red medallion
items.reason: Hand-knotted wool rugs hold value even with wear; check the back for knots.

items.name: Upright piano
items.reason: Uprights are usually free to a good home; moving costs more than they fetch.

items.name: Cast-iron skillet set
items.reason: Vintage cast iron sells reliably; check the bottom for a maker's mark.

items.name: Stand mixer
items.reason: Working stand mixers resell well regardless of age.

items.name: Sewing machine in cabinet
items.reason: Cabinet machines are common; the machine itself may be worth more than the cabinet.

items.name: Sofa, floral upholstery
items.reason: Upholstered seating rarely resells; worn fabric.

items.name: Recliner
items.reason: Everyday recliner, no maker visible.

items.name: Television, older flat panel
items.reason: Older TVs have little resale value.

items.name: Dining table and six chairs
items.reason: Common set; sells locally only if moved cheaply.

items.name: China cabinet
items.reason: Brown furniture like this is hard to give away.

items.name: Boxes of paperwork
items.reason: Keep for the estate, not for sale.

items.name: Everyday dishes
items.reason: Common stoneware.

items.name: Small appliances
items.reason: Toaster, kettle, coffee maker; donate or toss.

items.name: Queen bed frame and mattress
items.reason: Mattresses cannot be resold; frame is generic.

items.name: Dresser with mirror
items.reason: Solid but ordinary; a hauler's crew will take it unless someone wants it.

items.name: Closet of clothing
items.reason: Donate.

items.name: Twin bed
items.reason: Generic frame.

items.name: Bookshelves and paperbacks
items.reason: Paperbacks have no resale value; check for signed or first editions before boxing.

items.name: Garden tools
items.reason: Rusted hand tools.

items.name: Workbench with vise
items.reason: A bench vise alone can sell; the bench is usually left behind.
